bodySections.heading: Why timing matters for this schedule
paragraphs: Plan Cirneco dell'Etna social milestones around the schedule rows, not the other way around, because the 16-week finish is the usual green light clinics cite for broader Cirneco dell'Etna exposure.
Weight range 17-26 lb (8-12 kg) and grooming needs (Short coat.) belong in the same Cirneco dell'Etna household ops list as vaccine dates when busy weeks collide.
If your Cirneco dell'Etna is also monitored for eye issues, ask whether bloodwork or orthopedic checks can share a visit with a booster to cut missed Cirneco dell'Etna appointments.
After the Cirneco dell'Etna puppy/kitten series, keep adult DA2PP / DHPP and rabies renewals on 7/3/1-day reminders so year-two surprises disappear.

bodySections.heading: If a dose is missed or delayed
paragraphs: If your Cirneco dell'Etna misses the dose scheduled near week 12, call the clinic the same day with product names — do not restart the Cirneco dell'Etna series from memory.
The danger for a delayed Cirneco dell'Etna is the gap, not the embarrassment, because parvovirus pressure stays real for an under-vaccinated puppy even in clean-looking neighborhoods.
While waiting for the make-up DA2PP / DHPP visit, skip high-traffic dog parks / unknown-cat intros and keep the Cirneco dell'Etna away from unvaccinated animals.
After catch-up, rewrite reminders for the next Cirneco dell'Etna due date (7, 3, and 1 day prior) so the same miss does not recur.

faqs.question: When does the Cirneco dell'Etna core vaccine series usually finish?
faqs.answer: This breed record completes core vaccines around 16 weeks of age, with rabies timed per local law. Your clinic may adjust intervals for the individual puppy.

faqs.question: What should I do if my Cirneco dell'Etna misses a booster?
faqs.answer: Contact your veterinarian for a catch-up plan instead of restarting or skipping ahead. Keep prior dates handy and limit high-risk exposure until the series is current again.

faqs.question: Where can I read Cirneco dell'Etna health context beyond vaccines?
faqs.answer: See the Cirneco dell'Etna adult health guide for breed predispositions such as patellar luxation, then bring those notes to wellness and vaccine visits.
